import sys

# Monkey patch the function before importing the test
def is_body_allowed_for_status_code(status_code):
    if status_code is None:
        return True
    # Ref: https://github.com/OAI/OpenAPI-Specification/blob/main/versions/3.1.0.md#patterned-fields-1
    if status_code in {
        "default",
        "1XX",
        "2XX",
        "3XX",
        "4XX",
        "5XX",
    }:
        return True
    current_status_code = int(status_code)
    return not (current_status_code < 200 or current_status_code in {204, 205, 304})

# Inject the patched function into the module
import fastapi.utils
fastapi.utils.is_body_allowed_for_status_code = is_body_allowed_for_status_code

# Now run the tests
import pytest
sys.exit(pytest.main(['-v', 'tests/test_status_204.py']))
EOF
